actors.name: Employee
actors.private_context: Employee has been recommended for promotion by their manager. They are aware of the promotion process and hope it goes through before the end of the quarter. They have no direct control over the approval timeline.

actors.name: Manager
actors.private_context: Manager has submitted the promotion recommendation for Employee. They believe Employee deserves the promotion and have done their part. They are not the final decision-maker but can follow up if needed.

actors.name: HR Department
actors.private_context: HR Department processes promotion approvals. They have received the recommendation for Employee. They have standard procedures and timelines, but the exact processing time is not fixed. They may be influenced by workload and other priorities.

shared_context: The company has a promotion process that involves manager recommendation, HR review, and final approval. The end of the quarter is 2026-09-30. The promotion must be fully approved by that date to count as going through before the end of the quarter.

starting_events.description: Manager has submitted the promotion recommendation for Employee to HR.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the promotion is fully approved (all necessary signatures and system entries completed) before 2026-09-30T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
